page.notes: Uncertain readings: the Greek in §5 (ἑτέρῳ τοῦ λόγῳ, ἐπίσης) and the Greek word in §7 (illegible). The Greek fragments in the synopsis cells are partly illegible. "perfectissi-ma" is a guess at a line-end break. "Commune ad unum" and "vel [?]" in the synopsis are doubtful. The printed "enymum" in the synopsis (for "synonymum") is kept as printed. The catchword "Δίχ:" at the lower right is doubtful. The printed "limate" is kept as printed. "eoq;" keeps the printed abbreviation.
